attention2.ptxt: Touching a hot exhaust system component will cause a burn.
Do not perform any service work on the exhaust system until the exhaust system is cool.

attention4.ptxt: The turbocharger will lose its original performance if it is disassembled.
If any faulty condition is found, replace the turbocharger with a new one.

s1.ptxt: Drain coolant.
Remove catalytic converter.
Remove turbocharger water inlet pipe (1) and turbocharger water outlet pipe (2).
Disconnect waste gate control hose No.1 (3).
Remove turbocharger oil intake pipe (1) with oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 (2) and No.2 (3) and gaskets.
Remove oil drain joint (1) and oil drain joint gasket.
Remove turbocharger outlet air pipe (2).
Remove turbocharger inlet air pipe bolts (1) and turbocharger inlet air pipe bracket bolt (2).
Remove turbocharger (3) and gaskets.
Disconnect oil drain joint (1) from turbocharger oil drain hose (2), if necessary.
Remove turbocharger oil drain hose from cylinder block, if necessary.
Check mating surfaces and threaded holes of removed turbocharger for rust and, if rusted, remove the rust by grinding surfaces and tapping holes.

attention4.ptxt: If the turbocharger is to be reused, check the threaded holes in the flange and the mating surfaces for rust which may cause loosening of the bolts and nuts.
If rusted, remove the rust by grinding the surfaces and tapping the threaded holes.

s1.ptxt: Install new turbocharger oil drain hose (1) and oil drain joint (2) as follows, if removed.

s2.ptxt: Fit protector (3) and clip (4) to turbocharger oil drain hose.
Install turbocharger oil drain hose with new turbocharger oil drain hose clamps (5).
Connect oil drain joint to turbocharger oil drain hose.
Move protector to touch upper clamp as shown in figure and fix it with clip.

s1.ptxt: Install turbocharger (1) with new gasket, and then tighten turbocharger bolts (2) and nuts (3) to specified torque.
Install turbocharger inlet air pipe (1) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Install turbocharger inlet air pipe with new gasket to turbocharger.
Tighten turbocharger inlet air pipe bolts (2) and turbocharger inlet air pipe bracket bolt (3) by hand.
Tighten turbocharger inlet air pipe bolts securely.
Tighten turbocharger inlet air pipe bracket bolt securely.

s1.ptxt: Install turbocharger outlet air pipe (1) with new gasket.
Install oil drain joint (2) with new oil drain joint gasket (3) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Fit claws on gasket to oil drain joint flange.
Tighten oil drain joint bolts (4) securely.

s1.ptxt: Check mesh filter in oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 for cleanliness.
Install turbocharger oil intake pipe (1) with new gaskets, and then tighten turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 (2) and No.2 (3) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.1
Turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.2

s1.ptxt: Connect waste gate control hose No.1 (1) to turbocharger.
Install turbocharger water inlet pipe (2) with new gaskets, and then tighten turbocharger water inlet pipe union bolt (3) to specified torque.
Install turbocharger water outlet pipe (4) with new gaskets, and then tighten turbocharger water outlet pipe union bolt (5) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Turbocharger water inlet pipe union bolt
Turbocharger water outlet pipe union bolt

s1.ptxt: Install catalytic converter.
Refill cooling system with coolant.
Check cooling system for leakage.
